## What the change does
Security-driven dependency remediation: `maplibre-gl` 5→**6.9.0** (fixes the AttributionControl sanitizer XSS advisory), with the required compatibility work — swap the removed-internals `MapboxOverlay` (`@deck.gl/mapbox`) for upstream **`MapLibreOverlay`** (`@deck.gl/maplibre` 9.4.0), align deck/luma 9.3→**9.4**, add a shared same-origin worker initializer, declare `supercluster`/`@types/supercluster` explicitly, and scope an `fflate` override.

## Verification performed
- **No orphaned old adapter:** grep across `src` for `@deck.gl/mapbox`, `MapboxOverlay`, `map.transform` → zero matches. Only two `new maplibregl.Map` sites (`DeckGLMap.ts:840`, `NavigationPanel.ts:134`); both call `configureMapLibreWorker()` immediately before construction (`DeckGLMap.ts:839`, `NavigationPanel.ts:133`).
- **Installed APIs actually exist (not just typecheck claim):** `node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.d.ts` exports `setWorkerUrl` (17521), `IControl`, `MapEventType`, `AttributionControl` (17555). Worker asset `maplibre-gl-worker.mjs` present. `@deck.gl/maplibre` `overlay.d.ts:13` — `MapLibreOverlay implements IControl`, so dropping the old `as unknown as maplibregl.IControl` cast (`DeckGLMap.ts:885`) is correct. `setProps`/`finalize` (used at `DeckGLMap.ts:679/684/5007/6362`) are on the class — cleanup path compatible.
- **Lock resolutions:** `maplibre-gl@6.9.0` (10832), `@deck.gl/maplibre@9.4.0` (1919), top-level `fflate@0.7.5` (8884). `@loaders.gl/compression@4.5.1` declares `fflate 0.7.4` (3216) but the override redirects it to hoisted 0.7.5 — **no `@loaders.gl/compression/node_modules/fflate` nested entry exists**, so the vulnerable 0.7.4 is not installed. posthog `fflate@0.4.9` (12080), `@humanfs/node@0.16.8` (2554), `sharp` override `^0.35.3` — the #1716 patch set.
- **Worker/CSP:** `index.html:7` has `worker-src 'self' blob:`; the `?worker&url` import emits a same-origin `.mjs` served under `'self'`. `src/vite-env.d.ts:1` references `vite/client`, which supplies the `?worker&url` default-string typing. No CSP directive changed.
- **Functional equivalence:** `getMapStyleOptions()` returning `{ style }` spread into the constructor preserves mapbox→maptiler→OSM precedence (matches the style-precedence mutation test). The `appendChild/removeChild → append/remove` and gps-marker branch reorder in `NavigationPanel.ts` are behavior-preserving.
- **Mutation proofs** are internally consistent with shipped source (shipped `if (mapboxKey)` is the un-mutated form; `interleaved: true` present; `?worker&url` present).
